title: Make the evidence visible
thesis: A finding unfolds into its supporting evidence.
influence: Hyperbolic’s shift from rendered subject to line detail + Micro’s staged product reveal.
landing: An oversized finding panel separates into source, method and coverage layers. Continue into a modality selector with actual example output, a local-execution explanation, an annotated report preview and the product entry.
home: A horizontal application bar above a split workspace: example datasets on the left, a readable selected preview on the right.
results: A focused finding expands in place into verified rows, the method and coverage. The key expression retains its position throughout.
motion: A short, scroll-linked separation of evidence sheets; entering the app flattens the same sheets into working panels. One composed transition, then restrained disclosure.
risk: Strongest product reveal; risks decorative depth or small text. Keep evidence flat and readable once it becomes interactive.
mobile: Stack the evidence sheets in reading order; remove perspective and keep the finding visible above its evidence.
build: Independent layout and tokens. CSS transforms and SVG, with Motion or GSAP only for the opening sequence.

title: Read the finding
thesis: The report is the face of the product.
type: Newsreader + DM Sans / expressive titles, calm evidence
influence: AI in Design’s continuity from cover to chapter + Siena’s typographic specificity and subject framing. No film or ticket motifs.
landing: A confident report cover leads directly into an actual finding. Alternate short conclusions, annotated figures and source notes; show report exports, broader analysis families, method limits and local product entry.
home: A reading-oriented collection of bundled example reports with a prominent local-analysis action. It does not imply persistent saved history.
results: A continuous report with compact chapter navigation and evidence in the margin; selecting a note opens the underlying reference beside the prose.
motion: Large cover typography settles into a report heading. Chapter transitions are simple cuts and measured crossfades; no page-turn simulation.
risk: Clearest stakeholder communication; could underplay technical depth. Keep source references, denominators and methodology one action away.
mobile: Convert the chapter rail to a compact contents control; margin evidence follows its referenced paragraph.
build: Dedicated document layout; typography and CSS carry the identity. Minimal motion, accessible anchored sections.

title: See what changed
type: Barlow Condensed + IBM Plex Sans / compact display, legible measures
influence: Pudding’s explained relationships + ART+TECH’s bold data-led sections + Unseen’s clear visual shifts between chapters.
landing: Open on two real saved runs of Bike Hour: original and components removed. A shared baseline exposes what changes and what does not. Follow with single-dataset diagnostics, temporal/split/version capabilities, evidence scope, exports and product entry.
home: A wide toolbar and paired work area for one dataset or a supplied comparison. No permanent sidebar and no live-monitoring timeline.
results: Aligned evidence lanes with fixed row labels, shared chart scales and explicit population counts; the interpretation sits beneath both.
motion: Rows align before a change is emphasized; a user-controlled reveal compares views. Keyboard buttons provide the same information as dragging.
risk: Best for analytical differences; risks implying that removing a finding means success. Keep the scope and remaining questions alongside the comparison.
mobile: Toggle between the two datasets while retaining labels and scale, followed by a plain-language difference summary.
build: Separate comparison layout, SVG plots and accessible view controls. Two existing reports stay distinct from a newly executed comparison.

title: Follow the source
thesis: A bounded trail connects source, method and finding.
type: Space Grotesk / distinctive labels and open numeric forms
influence: Phantom’s overview-to-index change + Pudding’s relationship encoding. Translate navigation between evidence scales, not their visual effects.
landing: Start with source fields visibly forming one verified relationship. Selecting the finding reveals its actual evidence path. Continue with declared document reconciliation, modality examples, method/coverage disclosures, report exports and local entry.
home: A light workspace organized around supplied sources, with a selected local example and an explicit action to begin analysis.
results: A three-part source → method → interpretation view; only the selected relationship is drawn. Exact evidence IDs and source-row access remain visible.
motion: Selecting an evidence item traces its short connection and updates a stable inspector. The application uses no ambient graph movement.
risk: Most distinctive evidence navigation; can become a diagram that overwhelms the work. Bound the trail and always provide a table/list equivalent.
mobile: Show the three steps vertically with clear labels; retain a simple evidence list instead of a draggable canvas.
build: Dedicated source-oriented structure. Small semantic SVG paths and DOM inspectors; no force-directed network or 3D scene.

title: Open the work
thesis: Put the useful software in the first viewport.
influence: LPAS’s large, cropped subject panels + Studio Null’s reduction to a few decisive elements. Linear is a secondary check on dense interface legibility.
landing: A large, usable DataTrust excerpt sits under the company statement. Broad sections switch between a dataset table, findings inspector and report. Follow with modality examples, local workflow, methodology and a direct app entry.
home: A table-based local workbench with examples, a clear start action, top navigation and contextual previews.
results: An ordered findings list beside an evidence inspector; expanding a finding retains the list position. Flat material and deliberate spacing provide hierarchy.
motion: A crop opens to reveal the whole product, then ordinary direct manipulation takes over. Fast focus and selection feedback.
risk: Most immediately usable; greatest risk of looking like ordinary SaaS. Distinctive typography, broad composition and real interactive evidence must do the work.
mobile: Use a list-to-detail flow with a visible back control and preserved selection; the homepage product excerpt becomes a vertical sample.
build: Independent row-oriented layout and compact inspector. CSS transitions, semantic tables and keyboard-first controls.
